description: Publishes privacy-minimized organization candidates from the official Delaware current business-license dataset, grouping consistent repeated license rows while preserving trade names, business activities, validity dates, reported business-address evidence, provenance, quarantine, and explicit non-site semantics.
redirect_policy: Reject redirects and accept only HTTPS requests to the exact data.delaware.gov metadata and 5zy2-grhr JSON resource paths.
retry: Retry HTTP 429, 5xx, and transient transport failures with bounded exponential backoff. Do not retry redirects, other 4xx responses, schema drift, source refresh drift, count mismatch, or quality-gate failures.
checkpoint: The selected-field source snapshot is acquired in license-number order and hashed before normalization. Source metadata and counts are rechecked before publication. A complete unpublished staging run can be independently verified and resumed by immutable run ID. current.json changes only after complete publication.
idempotency: The source rowsUpdatedAt timestamp plus SHA-256 of the ordered selected-field source artifact identify a source release; the license number creates a stable provisional organization candidate.
cancellation: Abort network requests and local processing cooperatively, retain unpublished run-scoped staging for diagnosis, and do not change current.json.
retention_profile: Retain immutable internal selected-field source snapshots and local-review-only normalized releases until an approved retention operation removes them.
